verified_facts.text: The Tenuta di Roncolo estate is in the foothills of the Apennine mountains between Parma and Reggio Emilia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at the heart of Emilia, in the foothills of the Apennine mountains between Parma and Reggio Emilia, the Tenuta di Roncolo is an avant-garde agricultural estate.

verified_facts.text: The village of Roncolo, home to the estate, is part of the town of Quattro Castella.
verified_facts.excerpt: The village of Roncolo, home to the Tenuta di Roncolo, is part of the town of Quattro Castella

verified_facts.text: Villa Manodori, the villa at the heart of the estate, dates to 1670.
verified_facts.excerpt: The villa that anchors the estate dates to 1670.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites in Villa Manodori combine original frescoes with contemporary furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Original frescoes, contemporary furnishings, and generous proportions speak gently of the villa’s past, preserving its history.

verified_facts.text: The Manodori Master Suite has hand-painted fresco ceilings, a separate sitting room, a four-poster super-king bed, a deep tub and views over the historic park.
verified_facts.excerpt: with hand-painted fresco ceilings and a separate sitting room. A four-poster super-king bed, a bathroom with deep tub and walk-in shower, and wide views over the historic park.

verified_facts.text: The Dimora Garden Suite is a ground-floor suite with its own private garden or terrace opening onto the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: A ground-floor suite with its own private garden or terrace, opening straight onto the estate.

verified_facts.text: Rooms in the historic outbuildings of the Dimore have original wooden beams and are furnished with natural fabrics and modern antiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the first and second floors of the historic outbuildings, rooms and feature original wooden beams and are furnished with natural fabrics and modern antiques.

verified_facts.text: Villa Manodori rooms look over the formal gardens and the surrounding Tuscan-Emilian countryside.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooms open onto views of the formal gardens and the surrounding Tuscan-Emilian countryside.

verified_facts.text: The relais has a seasonal pool and a gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: seasonal pool / gym

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a guided tasting tour of the historic Acetaia di Canossa, where barrels age traditional balsamic vinegar over decades, ending with a tasting paired with aged Parmigiano Reggiano.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for a guided tasting tour in the historic acetaia, where wooden barrels quietly age and refine the _Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale_ over decades.

verified_facts.text: Sommeliers lead tastings of Venturini Baldini wines in the historic wine cellar of the seventeenth-century Dimora Ancini.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the cool, historic wine cellar of the seventeenth-century Dimora Ancini, our expert sommeliers guide guests through a curated tasting of Venturini Baldini’s award-winning wines.

verified_facts.text: The estate's classic Alfa Romeo Spider and Fiat Abarth can be rented on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our classic Alfa Romeo Spider and our Fiat Abarth are available to rent on request.

verified_facts.text: The estate chef teaches fresh pasta cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our estate chef will let you in to the culinary secrets of the Food Valley in a fresh pasta cooking class.

verified_facts.text: The 130-hectare estate is surrounded by the Parco di Roncolo nature preservation area and offers many kilometers of trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 130 hectare estate is surrounded by a natural preservation area, the Parco di Roncolo, and offers many kilometers of trails

verified_facts.text: Mountain bikes and electric bikes are available to rent.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mountain bikes and electric bikes are available for rent to explore the Apennine countryside.

verified_facts.text: The 18-hole Terre di Canossa Golf Club is ten minutes from the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just ten minutes from the estate, the 18-hole Terre di Canossa Golf Club offers a technically engaging course

verified_facts.text: Ristorante Limonaia is in the estate's converted historic greenhouse, with a terrace overlooking the vineyards and gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ristorante Limonaia opened in the estate’s converted historic greenhouse, its terrace overlooking the green of the vineyards and gardens.

verified_facts.text: The estate has been certified organic since 1994 and a certified B Corp since 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: the estate has been certified organic since 1994 and certified B Corp since 2025.

verified_facts.text: The estate is almost entirely energy self-sufficient, powered by solar panels, and is plastic-free.
verified_facts.excerpt: The estate is almost entirely energy self-sufficient, powered by solar panels. It is plastic-free.

verified_facts.text: The Prestia family took over the estate in 2015, when Villa Manodori had fallen into disrepair, and set out to restore it.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2015, the Prestia family arrived at a Villa Manodori that had fallen into disrepair, with a clear intention: not to transform the estate, but to restore it.

verified_facts.text: The estate is home to the historic Acetaia di Canossa balsamic vinegar cellar, dating back to the 17th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Tenuta di Roncolo is home to one of the largest and oldest vinegar cellars in Emilia, the historic Acetaia di Canossa, dating back to the 17th century.

verified_facts.text: The ruins of Canossa Castle overlook the surrounding Terre di Canossa landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ruins of Canossa Castle still overlook the landscape, a quiet reminder of the region’s historical weight.

verified_facts.text: The breakfast buffet offers organic products made in-house and from local producers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our delicious breakfast buffet offers a wide choice of organic products made in-house and from local producers.

verified_facts.text: All room types are pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: PET SERVICES

verified_facts.text: Roncolo welcomed its first guests in the summer of 2020.
verified_facts.excerpt: Roncolo welcomed its first guests in the summer of 2020.
